segments.contextAfter: Developers can express payment network preference in [`PKPaymentRequest`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/PassKit/PKPaymentRequest). Network preference is determined by the order of [`supportedNetworks`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/PassKit/PKPaymentRequest/supportedNetworks). This won’t override the user’s default card selection, but if the card is multi-SSD, then the network preference order determines which SSD is selected. (80827905)
